title: Advanced Negotiations
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Tienes el vocabulario necesario para sentarte en la mesa y negociar grandes acuerdos internacionales.

parts.visual:
Estrategias: 
- Leverage (Poder de negociación / Ventaja). 
- Compromise (Llegar a un acuerdo mutuo / Ceder). 
- Concession (Concesión - dar algo para obtener algo). 
Ej: We have strong leverage. If they want a compromise, they must make a concession.
parts.audio: Strategies. Leverage is your power or advantage in a negotiation. Compromise means to reach a mutual agreement by both sides giving up something. Concession is something you give to the other side. For example: We have strong leverage. If they want a compromise, they must make a concession.

parts.visual:
Tácticas y resultados: 
- Walk away (Retirarse de la negociación). 
- Deal-breaker (Factor decisivo para cancelar el trato). 
- Win-win situation (Situación donde ambos ganan). 
Ej: If the price is a deal-breaker, we have to walk away. We want a win-win situation.
parts.audio: Tactics and results. Walk away means to leave the negotiation. A deal-breaker is an issue that causes the negotiation to fail. A win-win situation is an agreement where both sides benefit. For example: If the price is a deal-breaker, we have to walk away. We want a win-win situation.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta de negociación.

questions.question: Because we are the only suppliers, we have a lot of ____ in this negotiation. (Poder/Ventaja).
questions.explanation: Leverage = ventaja o poder de negociación.

questions.question: We couldn't agree on everything, so we had to reach a ____. (Acuerdo intermedio / Ceder ambas partes).
questions.explanation: Compromise = acuerdo donde ambas partes ceden.

questions.question: They want us to lower the price. We should ask for a ____ in return. (Concesión).
questions.explanation: Concession = concesión (algo que se cede durante la negociación).

questions.question: We agreed to ____ the difference. We offered $100, they wanted $120, so we settled on $110. (Partir la diferencia).
questions.explanation: Split the difference = partir la diferencia a la mitad.

questions.question: A lack of technical support is a ____ for us. We won't sign. (Factor decisivo para cancelar el trato).
questions.explanation: Deal-breaker = condición inaceptable que rompe el trato.

questions.question: If they don't accept our terms, we have to be prepared to ____ away. (Retirarnos).
questions.explanation: Walk away = retirarse de la mesa de negociación.

questions.question: This agreement benefits both companies. It's a ____ situation. (Ganar-ganar).
questions.explanation: Win-win situation = situación en la que ambas partes ganan.

questions.question: We need to identify our bottom ____ before the meeting. (El límite / El precio mínimo o máximo aceptable).
questions.explanation: Bottom line = límite innegociable, lo mínimo o máximo aceptable.

questions.question: I'm sorry, but that price is non-____. We cannot change it. (No negociable).
They are driving a ____ bargain. They refuse to lower the price. (Negociación dura).
questions.explanation: Drive a hard bargain = negociar duro, ser inflexible.

questions.question: Let's put our cards on the ____ and be honest. (Cartas sobre la mesa).
questions.explanation: Put cards on the table = ser honesto y transparente sobre las intenciones.

questions.question: We managed to ____ a deal after three hours of negotiation. (Cerrar / Llegar a un trato).
questions.explanation: Strike a deal (o close a deal) = cerrar un trato.

questions.question: We need to ____ the contract to make sure there are no errors. (Redactar).
questions.explanation: Draft a contract = redactar un contrato (el borrador inicial).

questions.question: The negotiations have reached a ____. Neither side will compromise. (Punto muerto / Callejón sin salida).
To break the ____, we offered them a 5% discount. (Romper el bloqueo/hielo).
questions.explanation: Break the deadlock = salir del punto muerto.

questions.question: Can you give us a ____ figure for the total cost? (Cifra aproximada).
We shouldn't accept their first proposal. We need to make a ____. (Contraoferta).
They ____ our initial proposal, so we had to try again. (Rechazaron).
Let's find some common ____ before we start discussing the price. (Terreno común / Puntos de acuerdo).
questions.explanation: Common ground = puntos en común, intereses compartidos.

questions.question: The meeting went well, and we agreed in ____ on the main points. (En principio).
questions.explanation: Agree in principle = estar de acuerdo en lo general (faltando detalles).

questions.question: We have ____. (Ventaja/Poder con L)
To reach a ____. (Acuerdo mutuo/Ceder con C)
Make a ____. (Concesión con C)
A deal-____. (Factor de ruptura con B)
A ____ situation. (Ganar-ganar con W)
____ the difference. (Partir a la mitad con S)
The bottom ____. (Límite con L)
Make a ____-offer. (Contraoferta con C)
Reach a ____. (Punto muerto con D)
Common ____. (Terreno común con G)
